external_deps: A coding agent or a model provider

review.tagline: Generates a linked Markdown wiki of your repo for coding agents
review.summary: OpenWiki writes a Markdown wiki into `openwiki/` in a repository, tracks each fact back to source evidence, and updates only what changed. It installs as a skill plus MCP tools into coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot CLI, or runs as a standalone CLI with its own Deep Agents-based writer. Agents query it through local, model-free `openwiki_search` and `openwiki_read`.
review.audience: Teams giving coding agents persistent, searchable repo documentation
strengths: Installs into ten coding agents, reusing the host's authenticated model session
Claims tracked to source evidence; clean updates skip model calls
Search and read tools are local and read-only; workspaces span linked repos
Resumable page queue; scheduled CI examples for GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket
weaknesses: Agent-hosted runs cover repository wikis only; personal wikis need the standalone CLI
Connector-sourced context, including LangSmith, is not yet supported in host runs
Visualizer loads graph and Markdown libraries from a public CDN, so it needs internet
Native CLI needs a separately configured model provider and credentials
needs: Needs Node.js 22.22.0 or newer, A coding agent or a model provider
Models: Fourteen providers, including hosted models, Local OpenAI-compatible endpoints
